L6.1.quote: Key observation: a number m is a candidate for future terms iff gcd(m, a_i)>1 for all previous a_i. Equivalently, for every previous a_i, m shares a prime factor with a_i.
L6.1.note: Stated as an unproved observation; no argument that every such m actually appears.

L6.2.note: Finiteness of relevant primes is only conjectured ("Conjecture: there is a finite set of primes S"); no erasure argument.

L6.3.note: Periodicity asserted empirically ("Empirically the sequence is always eventually periodic"); no proof, and only eventual.

parsed.notes: Tracking file of computational exploration and conjectures; explicitly states "Full proof (Not yet complete.)". Characterization is named but unproved; finiteness and periodicity are conjectural/empirical only. Neither lower_bound (F) nor upper_bound (P) is established.
